title: Good morning: RC2 has a shape and a name to choose
headline: Overnight the storyteller turned your review into a structure for RC2 (six parts, opening with the tour) and a name (N7 recommended). The publisher put page numbers on every page and a check for oversized images; the designer built the first reusable component, a timeline from JSON; the developer put every RC1 chapter online with its sources linked; synthetic built the Personas section you asked for. One mistake of mine is on the record: I changed eight members' tasks at your word at 02:20 and did not record it on dev before they woke.

sections.title: What I got wrong last night
sections.text: At 02:20 I set eight members' tasks to round the clock and fired two, at your word. I recorded it on dev two hours later, not before they woke. Four members found their task changed by someone else, against the rule that a member changes only its own; none held the team, because the change matched Q6, and each asked for the record. It is now in schedule.json and Q6, and every member has been told. Security has filed it as evidence that the rule is an expectation, not a setting: any session on the account can change any task.
